question: Do the quoted-term (hybrid) search sets reproduce their published (database, HNSW) figures on the public search service, which answers quoted terms with exact ranking?
service: The public service (edge deployment), which answers every REST and MCP search; each search was the request its REST API builds for a semantic search with quoted terms: the question with its quoted terms, no filters and 50 results. 3 requests a second, at most 4 in flight, up to 4 attempts for a status other than 200 or 400. Latencies are client times from India.

sets_sent.id-quoted: data/marked-term-quality.jsonl, condition identifier (86): the short identifier query with its rarest term quoted (the identifier in 78 of 86).
sets_sent.para-quoted: data/marked-term-quality.jsonl, condition paraphrase (118): the fluent question with its rarest word quoted.
sets_sent.graded-end: data/placement-86.jsonl, systems.end (86): the graded study hybrid query (main Table 2), the rarest identifier appended in quotation marks.
sets_sent.relevance-86: data/hybrid-86-paired.jsonl, the relevance-selected term (86; Supplementary Table S7).
sets_sent.hybrid-332: data/hybrid-332.jsonl (332): the held-out question with its required term quoted (Supplementary Table S5).

corpus_filter: The live corpus held about 17.5 million records. live_14oct scores each list after removing every paper that is not in the tested 14 October 2026 version (membership from the saved DOI list of that version; 25486 of the 29439 distinct DOIs returned are in it). live_full scores the unfiltered list. hit10_vs_published compares live_14oct with published, the released reference ranks of each set (for id-quoted and para-quoted as first measured, before quoted terms in more than 20,000 records were declined).

paths.every paper that passes the filter, by i: At most 50,000 records contain the quoted term: every one of them is scored by a compact 8-bit copy of its embedding held beside the full-text index, the best 220 are re-scored with the full-precision embeddings and ranked with the formula of Supplementary Section S2.
paths.the Vectorize nearest that pass the filt: More than 50,000 records contain the term: the nearest papers by meaning that contain it are ranked, together with the term's best keyword (BM25) matches.

not_measured: nDCG@10 of the graded-end set is given for information only (ndcg10_14oct): unjudged_in_top10 of the 860 top-ten positions hold papers outside the assessed pool, so it is not comparable with the published 0.499.

files.per_search: data/quoted-live-2026-11-14.jsonl (identifiers and ranks only; in_2026_10_14 flags each paper of the 14 October version)
